usage: nacre-brain-maintain consolidate [-h] [--dry-run] [--report PATH]

Archive and triage old notes, refresh digests, wiki evidence, the index and
context packs, flag stale and contradicting facts and tidy the taxonomy, as
one verified, revertable commit. No model calls.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --dry-run      plan and print the summary; write nothing
  --report PATH  write a Markdown report outside the vault
